Which is a statement of one of Kepler’s laws of orbital motion?

  1. The square of the planet’s orbital period is proportional to the cube of the length of the semi-major axis of its orbit.
  2. A line segment joining a planet and the Sun sweeps out equal arc lengths during equal intervals of time.
  3. A planet’s orbital period is proportional to the cube of the length of the semi-major axis of its orbit.
  4. The orbit of a planet is an ellipse with the Sun positioned at the centre.
